image.subject: a late-18th-century Bavarian university professor in his late twenties, slim, powdered-hair style, dark frock coat with a white cravat, standing in a candle-lit room of a Bavarian university in 1776

storyboard.claim: A university professor in Bavaria starts a secret club in 1776.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Adam Weishaupt, the young professor, in a candle-lit university room.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opening hook, nothing before it.
storyboard.addedInformation: The founder's look and the date/place.

image.subject: a late-18th-century Bavarian university professor in his late twenties, slim, powdered-hair style, dark frock coat with a white cravat, leaning over a candle-lit table with a handful of young students in dark coats

storyboard.claim: The club is a small group of students around the professor, called the Illuminati.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The professor with a few students around one table.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the founding moment; same professor.
storyboard.addedInformation: The group is small, a handful of students.

image.subject: an empty candle-lit lodge room in Bavaria, the wooden table bare, its books gone and a single overturned chair, a government seal pinned to the door

storyboard.claim: Within a decade the government destroys the group.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The same room, now empty and abandoned.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The same lodge room, emptied after the crackdown.
storyboard.addedInformation: The state crushed it; the room shows the result.

image.subject: a British historian in his fifties, short greying hair, dark sport jacket over an open-collar shirt, seated at a wooden desk with books

storyboard.claim: Centuries later people still believe the group runs the world.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Niall Ferguson at his desk, speaking to camera.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Narrator returns after the destroyed lodge.

storyboard.claim: The central question of the book is how a dead network keeps its power.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only question card.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the myth claim; a real question.

image.subject: a long evening shadow falling across the cobbles of an 18th-century European capital square at dusk, no people in frame

storyboard.claim: A dead group casts a shadow over empires for two centuries.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A long shadow across an old European square.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Restates the question with a shadow image.

storyboard.claim: What about the group's structure frightened the establishment?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only question card.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Narrows the core question to structure.
storyboard.addedInformation: Structure is the key to the question.

image.subject: a British historian in his fifties, short greying hair, dark sport jacket over an open-collar shirt, seated at a wooden desk with books

storyboard.claim: The episode argues a new view of human history.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The historian at his desk introduces the argument.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Narrator transition to the argument.

image.subject: a lone guard in a dark cloak standing at the foot of a tall medieval brick tower, a closed iron-studded door in its base

storyboard.claim: For most of history power was violent and came from the top down.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A guard at the base of a closed tower.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The premise begins; the tower is introduced.

storyboard.claim: The tower stands for rigid hierarchy from the top down.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Three short text lines of the tower's traits.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Defines the tower from beat 8.

image.subject: a courier in a dark riding cloak on horseback on a dusty country road, a letter held up in one hand

storyboard.claim: Horizontal networks such as the square, the lodge and the courier rise from below.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A courier riding a road with a letter.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrast to the tower in beat 9.
storyboard.addedInformation: The courier is a network node.

image.subject: an ordinary person of any era in plain clothes, mid-thirties, seen from behind, among a crowd filling a 19th-century European town square at dusk, revolutionary banners overhead

storyboard.claim: Networks rise from the ground to undermine and beat the towers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A crowd seen from behind in a square at dusk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the square from beat 10.
storyboard.addedInformation: The crowd is the networks rising.

image.subject: a bronze statue of a king on a stone plinth in an empty city square at midday, pigeons on the steps

storyboard.claim: Textbooks focus on kings and leaders.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A king's statue on a plinth.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shifts from the networks to the leaders people remember.

image.subject: two ordinary men in plain coats passing a folded note between them in a dim doorway at dusk, seen from the street

storyboard.claim: Real historical change is driven from below, in the networks.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two men passing a note in a doorway.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the statues beat; turns to the networks.
storyboard.addedInformation: The engine is the note passing.

storyboard.claim: Host transition to unpack the idea.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Host banter, no picture needed.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Pure banter between hosts.

image.subject: the Piazza del Campo in Siena, Italy, seen from the city's brick tower at dusk, the wide shell-shaped square spread below

storyboard.claim: Siena's square and tower make the tension physical.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The Siena square seen from its tower.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves the tower and square to a real place.

image.subject: a massive 14th-century brick tower rising above the narrow streets of Siena, seen from a cobbled lane looking straight up

storyboard.claim: A 14th-century brick tower looms over the city.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The brick tower from a cobbled lane.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Zooms into the tower from beat 15.
storyboard.addedInformation: The tower dates from the 14th century.

image.subject: the grey brick face of a medieval civic tower against a red evening sky, its windows dark and high

storyboard.claim: The tower was built to project raw secular power.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The tower's grey face against a red sky.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the tower looks the way it does.

image.subject: a crowd of townspeople crossing a gorgeous shell-shaped brick public square in Siena, seen from behind

storyboard.claim: Below the tower is a public square built for people.
storyboard.concreteVisual: People crossing the shell-shaped square.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrast to the tower in beat 17.
storyboard.addedInformation: The square is a shell shape.

left.label: THE TOWER
left.subject: a lone guard at the foot of a massive brick tower, a door shut tight

right.label: THE SQUARE
right.subject: townspeople talking and trading in a wide open public square at midday

storyboard.claim: The tower is for power, the square for people.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two pictures side by side: tower and square.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Summarises beats 17 and 18.
storyboard.addedInformation: Two different ways of organising people.

image.subject: two ordinary people in plain clothes, seen from behind, leaning together at a stone well in a town square, talking and trading news

storyboard.claim: The square is where people trade, talk and spread rumours.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two people talking at a well.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the square from beat 19.
storyboard.addedInformation: Trade, talk and rumours in the square.

image.subject: a tall tower and an open square side by side in a European city at dusk, a single figure standing in the square between them

storyboard.claim: Two ways of organising people sit side by side in constant tension.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A tower and a square side by side with a figure between them.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Synthesis of the tower and square.

storyboard.claim: The book charts the battle through concrete factions and real people.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Four short text items: the factions.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets up the list of cases.

left.label: ADAM WEISHAUPT
left.subject: a late-18th-century Bavarian university professor in his late twenties, slim, powdered-hair style, dark frock coat with a white cravat

right.label: MAYER ROTHSCHILD
right.subject: an 18th-century Frankfurt merchant-banker in his fifties, stout, dark wool coat, round spectacles, ledger in hand

storyboard.claim: Adam Weishaupt and the Rothschild banking dynasty are the real people.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two portraits: the professor and the banker.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Names the real people from the list.

storyboard.claim: The story runs from the British Round Table to Zuckerberg.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only timeline card.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Extends the factions across time.

image.subject: a wooden desk stacked with old maps and books, a historian's hand resting on an open ledger in soft daylight

storyboard.claim: Understanding the tower versus the square is needed to understand power.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A desk of maps and books with an open ledger.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the tension matters.
storyboard.addedInformation: Power today depends on the tension.

image.subject: the island of Torcello near Venice at dawn, a small stone church rising above low brick houses by the still lagoon

storyboard.claim: Start in the 11th century to see how the tower was built.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dawn over Torcello's church and lagoon.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Host transition to the 11th century.
storyboard.addedInformation: The island of Torcello near Venice.

image.subject: an ordinary person of any era in plain clothes, mid-thirties, seen from behind, stepping through heavy wooden doors into a dim stone cathedral on the island of Torcello

storyboard.claim: Imagine walking into the Cathedral of Santa Maria Assunta on Torcello.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A visitor entering the cathedral doors.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Puts the viewer inside the cathedral.

image.subject: a heavy wooden cathedral door swung open onto a dim stone nave, incense smoke hanging in a slanting shaft of light

storyboard.claim: The cathedral smells of damp stone and centuries of incense.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Incense smoke in a light shaft through the door.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the walk into the cathedral.
storyboard.addedInformation: Sensory detail of damp stone and incense.

image.subject: a vast Byzantine-style gold mosaic of the Last Judgment covering the whole curved wall of a dim cathedral, glittering in candlelight

storyboard.claim: A massive mosaic of the Last Judgment dominates the cathedral.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The gold mosaic wall of the Last Judgment.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The mosaic is revealed after the entrance.
storyboard.addedInformation: The mosaic depicts the Last Judgment.

storyboard.claim: The mosaic is organised in strict tiers from heaven to hell.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Four short text lines, one per tier.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Breaks down the mosaic from beat 29.

image.subject: a gold mosaic figure of Christ enthroned in glory at the very top of a church wall, a row of angels in gold beneath him

storyboard.claim: At the top of the mosaic sits Christ in glory, with angels below.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Christ enthroned in gold above the angels.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Starts the top-to-bottom reading of the tiers.

image.subject: a row of robed saints standing in ordered rank along the stone wall of a cathedral, all facing forward

storyboard.claim: Everyone is perfectly ordered and nobody steps out of line.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Saints standing in rank facing forward.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the tier reading to the saints.

image.subject: the lowest band of a painted church wall, deep red and ochre flames curling in dim shadow, no figures clearly seen

storyboard.claim: At the bottom are the fires of hell, chaotic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Dark red flames in the lowest wall band.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The bottom tier of the mosaic.

storyboard.claim: The word hierarchy means the rule of a high one.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text-only quotation card.
storyboard.onScreenText: HIERARCHY: RULE OF A HIGH ONE
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Word origin supports the hierarchy point.

image.subject: a priest in a dark cassock raising a hand in a candle-lit stone nave, gold mosaic glowing behind him

storyboard.claim: The mosaic was political technology designed to tell people their place.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A priest before the glowing mosaic.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Reframes the mosaic as a tool of power.
storyboard.addedInformation: It was designed as political technology.

image.subject: an ordinary person of any era in plain clothes, mid-thirties, seen from behind, standing in a dim cathedral aisle looking up at a gold mosaic wall

storyboard.claim: Every illiterate peasant who entered learned his place from the mosaic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A figure looking up at the mosaic.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Puts a viewer in the peasant's place.

image.subject: a modest stone cottage at the edge of a muddy field at dusk, a single lit window

storyboard.claim: Each person was placed at the bottom of the grand scheme.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A humble cottage at the edge of a field.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the mosaic to ordinary life.

image.subject: a British historian in his fifties, short greying hair, dark sport jacket over an open-collar shirt, seated at a wooden desk with books

storyboard.claim: Human beings are biologically wired for horizontal connection.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The historian at his desk addresses the viewer.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from history to biology.

image.subject: a small group of hunter-gatherers in animal-skin cloaks sitting in a circle around a fire at dusk on an open plain

storyboard.claim: We evolved as horizontal hunter-gatherers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A group sitting around a fire on a plain.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Evolutionary origin of the horizontal wiring.
